rules.v: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights
rules.vi: Hukum ketenagakerjaan umum berlaku, atau undang-undang khusus memberi hak-hak intinya
rules.n: Labor laws apply to migrant caregivers, except the Hours of Work and Rest Law for live-in caregivers.

rules.f: Written contract in a language understood
rules.fi: Kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang dipahami
rules.v: Written contract required and provided in a language the worker understands
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis wajib dan tersedia dalam bahasa yang dipahami pekerja
rules.n: Written contract in a language the worker understands.

rules.v: Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
rules.vi: Upah minimum menurut undang-undang berlaku sama dengan pekerja lain

rules.v: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
rules.vi: Pembayaran minimal bulanan, terdokumentasi, dengan batas potongan atau upah natura
rules.n: Wage Protection Law applies; deductions for housing capped.

rules.v: No limit and no daily rest rule
rules.vi: Tidak ada batas dan aturan istirahat harian
rules.n: Hours of Work and Rest Law does not apply to live-in caregivers.

rules.v: Weekly rest provided but it may be worked for pay or another day, or is shorter
rules.vi: Istirahat mingguan ada tetapi boleh diganti uang atau hari lain, atau lebih pendek
rules.n: Weekly rest by extended agreement; not enforceable under the Rest Law.

rules.v: Equal to or longer than for other workers
rules.vi: Sama atau lebih panjang dari pekerja lain

rules.f: Keeping own identity and travel documents
rules.fi: Memegang dokumen identitas dan perjalanan sendiri
rules.v: Express right, or retention by employers prohibited with a penalty
rules.vi: Hak tegas, atau penahanan oleh pemberi kerja dilarang dengan sanksi
rules.n: Withholding a passport is an offence.
rules.s: Foreign Workers Law; Penal Law s. 376A

rules.v: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
rules.vi: Hanya standar akomodasi; tinggal di rumah majikan dapat diwajibkan

rules.v: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
rules.vi: Pindah hanya dalam keadaan tertentu atau setelah syarat terpenuhi
rules.n: Change within the caregiving sector with limits.
Recruitment fees capped by regulation; bilateral agreements reduce them further.

rules.v: Agencies licensed and liable to the worker (refund, return costs or joint liability)
rules.vi: Agen berizin dan bertanggung jawab kepada pekerja (pengembalian, biaya pulang atau tanggung renteng)
Hanya berdasarkan pengaduan atau pengawasan agen

rules.v: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
rules.vi: Pengadilan atau tribunal ketenagakerjaan setara pekerja lain, atau tanpa biaya

rules.v: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
rules.vi: Sebagian: hanya perawatan medis, kecelakaan kerja atau asuransi pemberi kerja
rules.n: Health insurance by the employer; partial National Insurance.

rules.f: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
rules.v: General criminal or civil law only
rules.vi: Hanya hukum pidana atau perdata umum

rules.v: May form and join trade unions
rules.vi: Boleh membentuk dan bergabung dengan serikat

laws.ti: Thailand-Israel Cooperation on the Placement of Workers (TIC): bilateral agreement on agricultural workers

decisions.nm: Kav LaOved v. Government of Israel
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.pe: In Israel, a migrant worker’s permit was tied to one employer. Leaving that employer meant losing legal status. The Supreme Court said this harmed workers’ dignity and freedom and told the government to change it.
decisions.pi: Di Israel, izin pekerja migran terikat pada satu majikan. Meninggalkan majikan berarti kehilangan status hukum. Mahkamah Agung menyatakan aturan ini merugikan martabat dan kebebasan pekerja dan memerintahkan pemerintah mengubahnya.

decisions.nm: Kav LaOved v. Ministry of Interior (pregnancy procedure)
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.pe: Israel’s rules said a migrant worker who had a baby had to leave the country or send the baby away. The Supreme Court said this rule was unlawful and cancelled it.
decisions.pi: Aturan Israel mewajibkan pekerja migran yang melahirkan meninggalkan negara itu atau mengirim bayinya keluar. MA menyatakan aturan itu tidak sah dan membatalkannya.

decisions.nm: Gloten v. National Labour Court (overtime for live-in caregivers)
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.pe: A caregiver from the Philippines claimed overtime pay for round-the-clock care work. The Supreme Court said the overtime law does not fit live-in care work and refused the claim, while calling for legislation.
decisions.pi: Seorang perawat dari Filipina menuntut upah lembur untuk kerja perawatan sepanjang hari. MA menyatakan UU lembur tidak cocok untuk perawat yang tinggal di rumah majikan dan menolak tuntutannya, sambil meminta pembuat UU bertindak.

decisions.nm: Adam v. Knesset (three-year detention of asylum seekers)
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.pe: Israel passed a law allowing people who crossed the border without papers to be held for up to three years. The Supreme Court struck it down. The Knesset then passed a new law, which led to the next cases.
decisions.pi: Israel membuat UU yang membolehkan orang yang melintasi perbatasan tanpa dokumen ditahan hingga tiga tahun. MA membatalkannya. Knesset lalu membuat UU baru, yang memicu perkara berikutnya.

decisions.nm: Eitan – Israeli Immigration Policy Center v. Government
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.pe: The Knesset’s second law also allowed long detention. The Supreme Court struck it down again and said a rule it had already cancelled could not come back in a slightly different form.
decisions.pi: UU kedua Knesset juga membolehkan penahanan lama. MA kembali membatalkannya dan menyatakan aturan yang sudah dibatalkan tidak bisa kembali dalam bentuk yang sedikit berbeda.

decisions.nm: Desta v. Knesset (length of stay at Holot)
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.pe: The third law allowed people to be held at Holot for 20 months. The Supreme Court allowed the facility but said 20 months was too long. Hundreds of people were released.
decisions.pi: UU ketiga membolehkan orang ditahan di Holot selama 20 bulan. MA membolehkan fasilitas itu tetapi menyatakan 20 bulan terlalu lama. Ratusan orang dibebaskan.

decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.pe: A law required employers to hold back a fifth of asylum seekers’ pay until they left the country. The Supreme Court cancelled it and ordered the money to be paid back.
decisions.pi: UU mewajibkan majikan menahan seperlima upah pencari suaka sampai mereka meninggalkan negara itu. MA membatalkannya dan memerintahkan uang itu dikembalikan.

decisions.nm: Tsegata v. Minister of Interior (removal to a third country)
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.pe: Israel planned to send Eritrean and Sudanese asylum seekers to a third country under a secret agreement. The Supreme Court allowed it, but limited detention of those who refused to 60 days.
decisions.pi: Israel berencana mengirim pencari suaka Eritrea dan Sudan ke negara ketiga berdasarkan perjanjian rahasia. MA membolehkannya, tetapi membatasi penahanan bagi yang menolak menjadi 60 hari.

decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.pe: A law stopped Israeli citizens from bringing spouses from the West Bank and Gaza to live with them. The Supreme Court, by one vote, let the law stand.
decisions.pi: Sebuah UU melarang warga Israel membawa pasangan dari Tepi Barat dan Gaza untuk tinggal bersama. MA, dengan selisih satu suara, mempertahankan UU itu.

decisions.nm: Adalah v. Minister of Interior (family unification)
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.pe: Temporary law barring family unification with spouses from the Occupied Territories.
decisions.pi: UU sementara yang melarang penyatuan keluarga dengan pasangan dari Wilayah Pendudukan.

help.de: Helps migrant workers, including Thai farmworkers, claim their rights; visits farms regularly and takes requests online.
help.di: Membantu pekerja migran, termasuk buruh tani dari Thailand, menuntut hak mereka; rutin mengunjungi pertanian dan menerima permintaan secara daring.
